thread:
maria (Docs): quick sync — legal asked us to add a short data-sovereignty footnote for EU and APAC pages. can we figure wording that is precise but not scary? :thinking_face:
aj (DevEx): ack. do we have a canonical phrase from legal or should i draft? i can also add an SDK example showing `x-region` header usage.
will (Legal): thanks for the ping. short version we prefer: 'Customer content may be processed and stored in the selected region and its underlying cloud provider locations.' keep it high level, no commitments about specific provider sub-regions.
maria (Docs): that wording looks good. can we pair it with a one-line callout on the region availability matrix, and link to the compliance page?
aj (DevEx): yes. proposal: add footnote marker on the region table cell -> footnote text exactly as will suggested + link to /compliance/data-sovereignty. also add an SDK snippet under "Region headers" that shows explicit region pinning.
yana (SDK): i can draft the snippet. small JS + curl examples. should we show both `region` query param and `x-redwood-region` header? legal prefers headers to be explicit.
maria (Docs): prefer header-only example to avoid confusing users. one snippet per language. keep it <6 lines. also need a short migration note for customers who relied on global endpoints.
will (Legal): migration note fine; add: 'Switching to a region-specific endpoint may affect routing and latency. Customer should test performance in target region.'
aj (DevEx): noted. i'll open a docs PR and tag @will for sign-off. PR will include: region table footnote, header-only SDK snippets, a brief migration paragraph, and one link update to /compliance. estimated patch: ~8 LOC + one new snippet file.
docs-bot: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 :white_check_mark: CI started.
maria (Docs): thanks @aj — i'll queue a content review and check link canonicalization. can someone run the link-checker script on staging? `scripts/link-checker --staging`
yana (SDK): running it now. small note: our Node snippet currently uses `region: eu-west` but servers expect `eu-west-1`. i'll change the snippet to the canonical slug.
aj (DevEx): good catch. i'll update the snippet file path too. will @will, can you glance at the final footnote text in the PR description before we merge?
will (Legal): will do. ETA 2 business days. if CI passes and link-checker is green, i'm fine with merging after my quick review.
maria (Docs): tiny nit — for APAC we should avoid saying "APAC" in the footnote; legal prefers full region names like "Asia Pacific (APAC)" in UI copy. pls update.
aj (DevEx): updated PR description and snippet. added one-line note: 'If you need on-prem or VPC-only deployments, contact sales.' to migration paragraph.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #459 :tada: link-checker: 0 broken links.
maria (Docs): great — @will please add your sign-off on the PR when you have a chance. after that i'll schedule a staged deploy to /staging for a final QA.
will (Legal): signed off in PR comments. good to merge from legal side.
aj (DevEx): merging after staging QA. thanks all. :rocket:
